\[
\begin{gathered}
L_{\text{h}} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & -1 & -1 \\ 2 & 2 & 2 \\ -1 & -1 & -1 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
R = \max_{d} \bigl( L_d \star I \bigr)
\end{gathered}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(L_d\): The line mask for direction d
- \(R\): The response

Each mask has a row of 2s along one direction and -1 elsewhere, so its weights add up to 0. A bright line one pixel wide along that direction gives a large positive response, flat areas give 0. The other masks are the same pattern turned to vertical and the two diagonals. With the max output, the strongest of the four responses is kept.
